name: io.github.Mnemosyne-OS/mcp
title: Mnemosyne OS
description: Memory the human governs, on their own machine, plus what other coding agents here wrote.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMO_DEFAULT_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Vault used when a call does not name one, and always reachable. Vaults are the user's own domains of memory, such as code, notes or a journal. Left unset, the server uses the first vault of MNEMO_VAULTS, or DEV when there is no list.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMO_VAULTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of the vaults this server may reach, besides the default. Once set, it is the whole list: a vault left out is refused. Left unset, the server reaches DEV, PERSONAL and SOCIAL.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMO_SDK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the local Mnemosyne OS SDK server the desktop app listens on.
